```yaml
descriptor:
  id: weekly-group-inventory
  name: Weekly Group Inventory
  description: Summarizes the group landscape in Microsoft 365.
  version: 0.1.0
  minAppVersion: 0.1.0
  author:
    name: Community
    handle: community
  category: policies
  mode: read

skills:
  - id: load_groups
    format: graph
    label: Load Groups
    detail: Load all groups from Microsoft Graph.
    settings:
      method: GET
      path: /groups
      select:
        - id
        - displayName
        - groupTypes
        - membershipRule
      scopes:
        - Group.Read.All

  - id: count_by_group_types
    format: transform
    label: Count Groups by Type
    detail: Count groups by their groupTypes.
    settings:
      kind: count-by-field
      source: "{{ load_groups.output }}"
      field: groupTypes
      buckets:
        - Unified
        - Security
        - Microsoft 365
        - Distribution

  - id: summarize_landscape
    format: llm
    label: Summarize Landscape
    detail: Summarize the group landscape.
    settings:
      system: You are an admin assistant.
      prompt: |
        Summarize the group landscape based on the following data:
        {{ count_by_group_types.output }}
      temperature: 0.7
      maxTokens: 200

definition:
  triggers:
    - id: manual
      kind: manual
    - id: weekly
      kind: scheduled
      intervalSeconds: 604800
  result:
    summary: |
      Group Landscape Summary:
      {{ summarize_landscape.output }}
    data:
      group_counts: "{{ count_by_group_types.output }}"
      summary: "{{ summarize_landscape.output }}"
```

```yaml
descriptor:
  id: top-noncompliant-models
  name: Top Non-Compliant Models
  description: |
    Loads managed devices, counts them by compliance state, sorts by last sync time,
    and summarizes the top 10 oldest devices.
  version: 0.1.0
  minAppVersion: 0.1.0
  author:
    name: Community
    handle: community
  category: devices
  mode: read

skills:
  - id: load_devices
    format: graph
    label: Load Managed Devices
    detail: |
      Retrieves all managed devices with selected fields.
    settings:
      method: GET
      path: /deviceManagement/managedDevices
      select:
        - id
        - deviceName
        - model
        - complianceState
        - lastSyncDateTime
      scopes:
        - DeviceManagementManagedDevices.Read.All

  - id: count_by_compliance
    format: transform
    label: Count Devices by Compliance State
    detail: |
      Counts devices grouped by complianceState with buckets for compliant, noncompliant, and unknown.
    settings:
      kind: count-by-field
      source: "{{ load_devices.output }}"
      field: complianceState
      buckets:
        - compliant
        - noncompliant
        - unknown

  - id: sort_by_last_sync
    format: transform
    label: Sort Devices by Last Sync Time
    detail: |
      Sorts devices by lastSyncDateTime ascending and takes the oldest 10.
    settings:
      kind: sort-by
      source: "{{ load_devices.output }}"
      field: lastSyncDateTime
      direction: ascending
      take: 10

  - id: summarize
    format: llm
    label: Summarize Top Devices
    detail: |
      Generates a concise summary of the sorted devices and compliance counts.
    settings:
      system: "You are a helpful assistant."
      prompt: |
        Summarize the following data:

        Devices (oldest 10):
        {{ sort_by_last_sync.output }}

        Compliance counts:
        {{ count_by_compliance.output }}

        Provide a concise summary of the top non-compliant models.
      temperature: 0.7
      maxTokens: 200

definition:
  triggers:
    - id: manual
      kind: manual
  result:
    summary: "{{ summarize.output }}"
    data:
      load_devices: "{{ load_devices.output }}"
      count_by_compliance: "{{ count_by_compliance.output }}"
      sort_by_last_sync: "{{ sort_by_last_sync.output }}"
      summarize: "{{ summarize.output }}"
```

```powershell
# Connect to Azure AD
```

```powershell
# Connect to Azure AD
```
